prompt: Discuss the impact of single-use plastics on the environment. What steps can individuals and governments take to reduce this impact.
essay:
As society evolves, there has been an ongoing debate regarding whether  disposable plastics may place a significant pressure on the environment.  A group of individuals believe that government can have a central or  irreplaceable role in bodyguarding and regulating environmental laws, while others claim that every person is a powerful tool for protecting together by avoiding using utensils. Therefore, ahead of my opinion, both views will be discussed further.

Examining the former perspectives, the primary argument that supporters would put forward is that nowadays citizens are excessively using single-use plastics, which can have detrimental consequences on environmental protection. This occurs because when people use plastics and then throwaway on the road or in landfills, affecting to the marine life or releasing amount of carbon dioxide.

The advantages of government and individuals should not be underestimated. This is due to the fact that policymakers should impose stricter environmental regulations or penalties on factories or industries with the ultimate goals of preventing damage and promoting sustainability. For example, authorities should adopt environmental laws by limiting the production of disposable plastics, which can reduce the amount of emissions released or decrease  air pollution. Turning to citizens, each human can have a crucial role in working together to make the environment eco-friendly. This is because they can avoid using utensils like plastic bags or take-away boxes, which have had a devastating effect on our soil or oceans.

In conclusion, although the government can handle  the impact of environmental protection by applying restrictions to industrial manufacturers. Individuals can also bring high benefits for the environment by using renewable products instead of using disposable plastics, which reduce amount of effect on the ecosystems.
